_about: Honest record of how accuracy and data-completeness moved across runs because of the verification loops. Accuracy is vs the 20-app gold sample; completeness = apps with a conclusive auth + access out of 100.

stages.what: Naive agent: one search + one scrape per app. MCP undetected, thin docs pages wrongly marked 'not-an-api', over-restrictive query returned nothing for ~a third of apps.

Diagnosed the misses, then fixed: reviewer-seeded MCP map, recover auth from the already-scraped pricing page, and a verdict rule that won't call something 'not-an-api' on a thin extraction. Recomputed entirely from cache.

Scrape each app's documentation hint URL directly instead of guessing via search — more accurate and ~half the credits. Filled 32 of 35 'unknown' apps; verdict distribution became realistic. (Sample accuracy is noisy at n=20; the real win is completeness + trustworthy patterns.)
